verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a community benchmark. It shows Ollama running integer-quantized model variants (q4_K_M and int4) via 'ollama run', so the product does run 4-bit integer quantized models. There is no first-party documentation of quantization formats, and nothing covers the range from very low-bit to 8-bit. missing for 10: first-party docs on supported quantization levels, evidence of sub-4-bit and 8-bit options, evidence of actual memory-footprint reduction, any user-side quantize/convert capability.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can reduce memory footprint using integer quantization ranging from very low-bit to 8-bit precision
